title: Sharp adaptive tail gate with prescribed interior mass
body:
This scoped theorem gives the sharp worst-case adaptive tail criterion with a prescribed mean and interior mass. Two explicit endpoint laws determine the envelope, and an attaining mixture proves the strict boundary. An integer three-rank fixture passes the original tail/ordering gates where the earlier range-and-mean guarantee fails; its mirror coverage still fails. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ba5473db1513aa96824232dd33fcb363aca44cbd/research/interior-mass-tail-gate/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ba5473db1513aa96824232dd33fcb363aca44cbd/research/interior-mass-tail-gate/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ba5473db1513aa96824232dd33fcb363aca44cbd/research/interior-mass-tail-gate/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ba5473db1513aa96824232dd33fcb363aca44cbd/research/interior-mass-tail-gate/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 150 rational statistic fixtures, 1,050 envelope comparisons and attaining cases, 77 chord checks, three original gate inequalities and seven controls. Both print `PASS_INTERIOR_MASS_TAIL_GATE`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/interior-mass-tail-gate
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted CI has not yet been checked. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Apply the interior-mass screen to a source-bound histogram that also passes every mirror and recurrence predicate. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #5254](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5254) supplies the normalized criterion, sharp endpoint screen and explicit interior-mass question in its [proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c2625f5488b09e6d19b4bed7efe8b4e89a6782/research/adaptive-tail-entropy/PROOF.md). That proof records Dillon Amburgey's [PR #4532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4532) scalar-to-gate equivalence, and the compiler lineage of zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and Ryanson Jonathan. Those are retained premises and credits. Convex chord bounds and extremal moment methods are classical; the contribution is the sharp interior-mass adaptive boundary and the source-gate discriminator.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
